'''Chapter 599''' is titled "Nine Pirates".

==Cover Page==
"Luffy Gets Put to Sleep by Sheep and has his Food Stolen" - a request by 'Twin Mother (双子母)' in Hyogo Prefecture.

==Short Summary==
All of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] have arrived at [[Sabaody Archipelago]] and begin to meet up at the [[Thousand Sunny]]. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] demonstrates his now controlled [[Haki]] on [[Demaro Black|Fake Luffy]]. [[Franky]] demonstrates his new upgrade to [[Nico Robin|Robin]]. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] gets on a departing pirate ship, intending to go fishing, and instead slices the ship in half, demonstrating some of his new skills in swordsmanship, commenting that he got on the wrong ship.

==Long Summary==

The rest of the Straw Hats are shown in further detail. At the start, there is a flashback where [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is shown on the Kuja Pirates' ship prior to landing on Sabaody. [[Boa Hancock]] advises Luffy to be discreet and not arouse attention, since his face is widely known due to the events that took place two years ago. The flashback ends with Luffy saying goodbye to the Kuja Pirates and promising Hancock that he will see her again (she again interprets this as a marriage proposal, which Nyon quickly corrects). The next scene returns to the confrontation between the fake Straw Hats and Luffy. The fake Luffy brags about his {{B}}400,000,000 bounty to the real Luffy and demands that Luffy beg on his knees to be forgiven for knocking him over. Luffy excuses himself and begins to leave. The fake Luffy quickly decides to shoot him, but Luffy easily dodges the bullet and renders them unconscious using his Haki.

Meanwhile, [[Nico Robin|Robin]] is shown arriving at the Thousand Sunny, commenting that they left the ship alone for two whole years. She is then greeted by the new and improved [[Franky]], who says that this might be his first and probably last improvement on his body. After a few topics being discussed by the two (like Robin being the 8th member to arrive and Rayleigh's coating on the ship), Franky comments on Brook's newfound success and wonders whether or not he will actually return to the "pirate life".

Brook is shown in concert, singing. The chapter progresses as the fake Straw Hats regain consciousness. [[Demalo Black|Fake Luffy]] hardens his resolve to find Luffy, [[Nami]], and [[Usopp]]. However, Fake Luffy is informed that [[Cocoa|Fake Robin]] has been kidnapped. He decides to leave her behind, which angers [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], who is still under the impression that they are the real Straw Hats. Chopper storms off to find Robin. As he walks away, Marines are revealed behind the corner, convinced that the fakes are real due to Chopper's presence among them. They report to G1 that the Straw Hats are alive. [[Sentomaru]] hears of this and decides to take himself, PX-5, and PX-7 to Sabaody. The chapter ends with [[Sanji]] witnessing a one-eyed [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] emerging from the ocean, having cut in half a coated pirate ship that he had accidentally boarded.

==Quick Reference==

===Chapter Notes===
*[[Marguerite]], [[Sweet Pea]], and [[Aphelandra]] are now part of the [[Kuja Pirates]].
*For the first time, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is shown consciously using [[Haki|Haoshoku Haki]] to knock out a group of people. This is the first fight Luffy is shown to win without throwing a punch and, like [[Silvers Rayleigh|Rayleigh]], Luffy demonstrates the ability to win a fight without even touching his opponents.
*[[Demalo Black|Fake Luffy]] briefly mentions that Luffy's [[bounty]] has increased to {{B|S}}400,000,000, presumably due to his actions at [[Impel Down]] and [[Marineford]].
*The real name of Fake Robin, [[Cocoa]], is revealed.
*[[Franky]] fully reveals his new appearance.
*[[Sentomaru]] appears for the first time after the time skip and is now a [[Marine]].
*The [[Thousand Sunny]] is ready for departure. Some of Sunny's weaponry has been upgraded by Franky.
*It is revealed by a fisherman that [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] is possibly blind in his left eye.
*Zoro cutting the ship in half is reminiscent of when Mihawk did the same to Don Krieg's ship.
*[[Chocolat|Fake Nami]] and Fake Luffy have now both stuck a pistol at their counterpart's face, and both times flaunted "their" bounties as a sign of power in order to threaten their counterparts, all the while not knowing they were threatening the real deal.

==Trivia==
*Zoro is now illustrated correctly, with his left eye scarred, rather than his right (a mistake by Oda).
*The spelling of "Monkey D. Luffy" on the recruitment poster is corrected, as opposed to the mistake in the previous chapter, which reads as "Monky D Luffy".
*Ironically, Fake Sanji was correct about the fact that having the real Chopper in their group would make them appear to look more like the real Straw Hats, as the Marines mistook them to be the real crew due to Chopper being with them.
